- Frequency:

## Reproduce

1. Initial state, mode and relevant save data.
2. Exact input and route.
3. Observed result.

## Expected and actual behaviour

Describe the difference without changing acceptance criteria to match the defect.

## Evidence and checks

Attach logs, screenshots or recordings without credentials. Include the command result and whether a real controller or target Mac was tested.

## Dependencies and resolution

Name blockers, the fix plan, regression test and evidence needed to close. A local Linux pass does not close a macOS-only defect.
